## What Is a Pew Research Center Internship?


A Pew Research Center internship is a paid summer placement in Washington, DC, offered through the Center's flagship summer internship program. Pew Research Center describes itself as nonpartisan and nonadvocacy, and its[careers page](https://www.pewresearch.org/about/careers/) says it has more than 180 people on staff. Interns are placed on a team such as Data Labs, Global Attitudes and Trends, Survey Methods, Internet and Technology, News and Info, Religion or Social and Demographic Trends, with some placements on operations teams like communications. This page covers Pew Research Center, not the separate careers site of The Pew Charitable Trusts.

### Why You Must Apply the Week Applications Open


Pew's postings are hard-deadline ones, and unsuccessful candidates aren't notified until a position closes, so a late application can't be rescued by a later round. Pew hasn't published an applicant count or acceptance rate, and we could not source one. Because each team takes its own application and cover letter, apply to several teams in the first week and don't wait for the deadline to write them all.

## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


What is documented about who can apply:


• **Education:** undergraduate students, as third-party listings describe it. Pew's own 2027 wording is not published yet. A third-party listing for one 2026 requisition said rising juniors and seniors.


• **Work authorization:** not published on Pew's own pages we could reach. Check the requisition itself when the 2027 postings go live.


• **Location:** Washington, DC. Pew states all its jobs are based in its DC office, with no full-time remote work.


• **Application:** a cover letter is required for a complete application, and each role needs its own.


• **Graduate students:** Pew's own descriptions we found say undergraduate, so we don't state graduate eligibility.


### Is There a GPA Requirement?


We found no GPA figure in anything Pew published or in the listings that relay it. What Pew does emphasize is fit: a tailored cover letter for each team and interest in research. Because the official internships page was unavailable on 16 October 2026, re-check the requisition itself when the 2027 wave posts.

## What Is the Pew Research Center Application and Interview Process Like?


Pew's process, as far as its own pages show, runs like this:


1. **Watch the Workday internship site:** it's empty between cycles, so check[the board](https://pewtrusts.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/CenterInternships) regularly through the winter.


2. **Write a cover letter for each team:** Pew says cover letters are required for a complete application, and multiple roles need separate applications and cover letters.


3. **Apply in the first week:** Pew has not published the window length on its own pages, and the close is a hard date.


4. **Interviews:** timing is not published on Pew's own pages. Pew describes two to three interview rounds for staff roles.


5. **Decisions:** Pew says unsuccessful candidates aren't notified until the position closes.


Expect slow communication. Applicants in a past cycle reported waiting weeks without replies.

## How Do You Stand Out for a Pew Research Center Internship?


Three moves. First, write each cover letter for a specific team. Pew says cover letters are required and that every role needs its own, so a letter that names the team's research area and what you'd contribute is the screen. Second, apply to several teams. Applicants in a past cycle reported that teams decide separately, with one rejection arriving while two others were still pending. Third, show you can work with data and write about it. Pew's description says interns may learn statistical software and publish a blog post, so a short analysis or writing sample from a class project is useful evidence.

## FAQ


### Can I still apply for a summer 2026 Pew Research Center internship?


No. The summer 2026 requisitions have closed, and Pew's internship site on Workday shows 0 jobs as of 16 October 2026. Pew has not published dates for the next cycle on its own pages, so watch the Workday internship site for summer 2027 postings.


### When do Pew Research Center internship applications open for summer 2027?


Pew has not published the summer 2027 application dates on its own pages, and its internships page wasn't available on 16 October 2026. The Workday internship site is empty between cycles, so check it regularly through the winter and apply in the first week once postings appear.


### How much do Pew Research Center interns earn?


Pay is not published on Pew's own pages we could reach, and its internships page wasn't available on 16 October 2026. Check the requisition on the Workday internship site when the 2027 postings go live, and ask about pay before you plan around it. Do not rely on third-party figures.


### Is the Pew Research Center internship remote?


No. Pew says all its jobs are based in its Washington, DC office and that it doesn't offer full-time remote work. The intern arrangement for telework isn't stated, so plan for in-person work in DC and ask about housing and commuting before accepting an offer.


### Who is eligible for a Pew Research Center internship?


Third-party listings describe the program as open to undergraduate students. Pew's own pages we could reach don't publish eligibility or work-authorization wording, and graduate eligibility isn't stated either, so confirm both on the requisition when Pew posts the 2027 internships.


### When will I hear back from Pew Research Center?


Pew has not published its interview or decision timing on its own pages. It says unsuccessful candidates aren't notified until the position closes, and applicants in a past cycle reported waiting weeks. Expect slow communication, and watch the posting and your email after you apply.


### Which teams hire Pew Research Center interns?


Pew's description lists research teams such as Data Labs, Global Attitudes and Trends, Survey Methods, Internet and Technology, News and Info, Race and Ethnicity, Religion, Science and Society, Social and Demographic Trends and US Politics, plus operations teams like communications. Which hire in 2027 shows when postings go live.


### Do I need a cover letter for a Pew internship?


Yes. Pew's careers page says cover letters are required for a complete application, and applying to multiple roles means a separate application and cover letter for each. Tailor each letter to the team, since teams appear to review their own applications, and write them well before the deadline.
